paite: Hiai pen na kiang ua ka hong athumveina ding ahi. "Theihpih nih hiam, thum hiam kam ah thu chiteng hihkip in a-om ding hi."
heading: Paul Thuneihna
english: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”

paite: Ka genkholta a, anihveina a na kiang ua ka om lai a ka gen bang in, tu'n ah na kiang ua om lou in, tuma lam a thil hihkhialte kiang ah leh midang tengteng kiang ah ka genkhol nawn dek hi, ka hong nawnleh ka hawi kei ding, chih;
english: I have warned previously, and I warn again, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now and to all the rest that if I come again, I will not spare,

paite: Khrist keimah a thu gen zelpa pen chetna na zon ziak un, amah zaw noumau lam ah ahat lou kei a, na lak uah thilhihtheitak ahi zaw hi.
english: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak, but is powerful in you.

paite: Hatlouhna a kilhlup himahleh Pathian thilhihtheihna ziak in ahing hi. Kou leng amah ah ka hat kei uhi, himahleh, noumau lam a Pathian thilhihtheihna ziak in akiang ah ka hing sam ding uhi.
english: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.

paite: Ginna ah na om na uhiam chih noumau ngeingei ki-enchian zel un. Ahihkeileh noumau ah Jesu Khrist a-om chih noumau ngeingei in na theichian kei ua hia? Deih louh na hih kei ngal uleh.
english: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.

paite: Koute deih louh in ka om kei uh chih na thei lai ding un ka gingta hi.
english: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.

paite: Huan thil himhim na hihkhelhlouhna ding un Pathian kiang ah ka ngen zel uhi; koute deihhuai a ka lattheihna ding uh ahi kei a, koute deih louh in om mah le ung noute'n akilawm peuhmah na hihtheihna ding uh ahi zaw hi.
english: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.

paite: Thutak gum ding lou in zaw, thutak dou ding in bangmah ka hihthei kei uhi.
english: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

paite: Koute ka hat louh lai un noute na hat ua, ka kipak uhi; noumau hoih lam a na kibawlphat uh thumna a ka nget uh ahi.
english: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.

paite: Huaiziak in hihse ding hilou a bawlhoih ding zaw a, Toupa'n thuneihna ahon piak bang zel in, na kiang ua ka om chiang a nakpitak a ka hon taihilhlouhna ding in, na kiang ua ka om louh lai in hiai thu ka gelh ahi.
english: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.

paite: Atawp pen in, unaute aw, kipaktak in om un, na omdan uh kitungding unla; ka hon ngetna limsak un, kikhamuantuah in om unla; lungsim mun khat pu unla, kituaktak in om un; huan na kiang uah itna leh khamuanna Pathian a-om ding hi.
heading: Chibai Bukna
english: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.

paite: Tawp siangthou in chibai kibuk un.
english: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

paite: Misiangthou tengteng in chibai ahon buk uhi.
Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna, Pathian itna, Kha Siangthou kithuah-pihna na vek ua tung ah om hen, Amen.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.
